---
title: Media
---

```{=html}
<style>
/* PLANTED: color-contrast (serious), dark cells only. The light rule passes
   comfortably; the dark one is 1.7:1. Proves the theme axis of the scan matrix
   finds something the default cell cannot. */
.axe-fixture-dark-only { background: #ffffff; color: #1a1a1a; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .axe-fixture-dark-only { background: #333333; color: #555555; }
}

/* PLANTED: color-contrast (serious), narrow viewports only. Same idea on the
   other axis: passes at 1440x900, fails at 390x844. */
.axe-fixture-mobile-only { background: #ffffff; color: #1a1a1a; }
@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .axe-fixture-mobile-only { background: #f0f0f0; color: #f8f8f8; }
}
</style>
```

{{< include _systemic.qmd >}}

Keep the two paragraphs below free of inline code, links and any other element
that carries its own colour: a nested colour would add a second, unplanned
contrast failure and make the fixture depend on the theme's palette.

::: {.axe-fixture-dark-only}
This paragraph fails colour contrast only when the preferred colour scheme is
dark.
:::

::: {.axe-fixture-mobile-only}
This paragraph fails colour contrast only at a narrow viewport.
:::
